summary: Tank who trades with %HP damage from his passive, peels with stuns and knockbacks, and at level 5 can turn into an all-in fighter. He beats bruisers who rely on long fights; true damage and kiting beat him.
threats: Passive (Dauntless Instinct) marks you; his next hit deals bonus %max HP damage.
Q (Ntofo Strikes) stacks; the third cast is a shockwave that pulls you in.
W (Path Maker) cuts the damage he takes while charging, then dashes and knocks you back or stuns.
R (All Out) at 5 kicks you away (through walls if close) and swaps his tankiness for damage.

matchups.why: Vitals deal true %HP damage, so K'Sante's armor and MR don't matter. Riposte parries his W stun or Q3 pull and turns it back on him, and when he goes All Out he gives up the tankiness that was keeping him alive.
trading: Hold W (Riposte) for his W dash or Q3 pull; both are trade-defining.
After the parry, Lunge onto vitals while he's stunned.
If he goes All Out (R), he's lost his tankiness. That's your window to kill him.
Don't fight with your back to a wall; R can kick you through it.
matchups.early: Trade on vitals from level 1. Make him use Q stacks on the wave, not on you.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R heal zone wins extended fights; his R makes him squishier, not stronger against you.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and fight in his cooldown windows.
matchups.jungle: He has strong peel. Gank after he's used W.
matchups.remember: Parry the W or Q3, then hit vitals.

matchups.why: W (Silver Bolts) true %HP damage ignores K'Sante's tank stats, and Vayne out-ranges his short Q. Condemn knocks him back during his W dash, so he has a hard time ever landing his engage.
trading: Auto him whenever he walks up; his Q range is short and he can't trade back.
Tumble (Q) away from his Q3 pull before the third cast comes out.
Condemn him into a wall when he charges W to stop his dash.
Don't stand near walls when his R is up; he can kick you through them.
matchups.early: Kite and farm. He can't reach you without landing W, so poke him every time he walks up.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R kicks you toward his team or tower. Stay away from walls.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and kite; take plates when he backs to buy armor.
matchups.jungle: He's slow without W or E. Gank once those are down.
matchups.remember: Kite the W, true damage the tank.

matchups.why: Darius out-damages K'Sante early with Hemorrhage stacks, but W (Path Maker) cuts the damage K'Sante takes and knocks Darius out of range mid-combo. The lane comes down to who wastes their key spell first: your E or his W.
trading: Bait his W with a walk-up first; E (Apprehend) pull only once W is on cooldown.
Stack Hemorrhage quickly with W (Crippling Strike) and autos before he can knock you away.
Walk inside or out of his Q3 shockwave path. Don't get pulled into a bad position.
When he's All Out (R), he loses his resistances. That's when your R execute is strongest.
matchups.early: Levels 1–3 slightly favor you if you trade while his W is down. Don't extend into a full Q3 rotation.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R resets on kill; his R can kick you away from the fight. Fight in open space away from walls.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and trade when he walks up to farm.
matchups.jungle: He's gankable once W and E (Footwork) are both down.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Armor-pen items; anti-heal isn't a priority.

matchups.why: K'Sante's Q poke and %HP passive damage bully Nasus early, and his W knockback stops Nasus walking up to stack. Nasus can only farm safely and outscale.
trading: W (Wither) him the moment he charges W to slow his follow-up.
Stack Q on minions when his Q is on cooldown; avoid standing in his Q3 range.
E (Spirit Fire) lowers his armor, which helps your Q stacks hit harder later.
Don't fight near walls when his R is up.
matchups.early: Farm under tower and survive. Concede some creeps rather than taking his trades.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R gives HP and resists to survive his all-in; use it defensively, not to start fights.
matchups.wave: Let him push and farm under tower; stack Q on cannon minions.
matchups.jungle: Ask for early ganks when he overextends without W.
